sana.title: SANA-Video 2.0- Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation

cases.question: What three stages does Stable Video Diffusion identify for training video latent diffusion models?
cases.expected_evidence_scope: single-paper SVD; native-text pages describing text-to-image pretraining, video pretraining, and high-quality video finetuning
cases.pass_condition: qa export status OK with evidence whose paper_id is SVD; imported answer cites those chunks; claims about the three stages are checked against exact slices

cases.question: What is VBench and what kind of evaluation does it provide for video generative models?
cases.expected_evidence_scope: single-paper VBench; title/abstract describing a comprehensive hierarchical benchmark suite
cases.pass_condition: qa export status OK with VBench paper_id in evidence; answer claims about the benchmark purpose match cited slices

cases.question: How does SANA-Video 2.0 combine linear attention and softmax attention, including the reported ratio?
cases.expected_evidence_scope: single-paper SANA-Video 2.0; hybrid linear-softmax attention and 3:1 ratio
cases.pass_condition: qa export status OK with SANA paper_id in evidence; numeric ratio and method name checked against cited slices

cases.question: How do SANA-Video 2.0 hybrid linear attention and Stable Video Diffusion latent video diffusion models differ as approaches to video generation?
cases.expected_evidence_scope: at least two papers (SANA and SVD). If one retrieval is short, record shortage or narrow the conclusion; do not invent missing context. One labeled query rewrite is allowed only if the first result is kept.
cases.pass_condition: first qa export retained; comparison claims only use returned evidence; if fewer than two papers appear, mark insufficient rather than stitching

cases.topic: 高效视频生成：混合线性注意力与潜在视频扩散训练
cases.requirements: 用中文写一篇 300 到 600 字的短草稿，只根据给定证据比较 SANA-Video 2.0 的混合线性注意力与 Stable Video Diffusion 的潜在视频扩散训练阶段。必须引用至少两篇论文的 chunk。不要编造未给出的数字或方法。
cases.expected_evidence_scope: writing export with exactly these two paper_id filters; evidence from other workspace papers must be dropped
cases.pass_condition: writing export evidence paper_ids ⊆ the two listed ids and exclude VBench and Video Diffusion Models; draft 300–600 Chinese characters citing at least two papers. If evidence is insufficient, keep the under-bar result.
